title: Homotopic maps of simplicial sets induce chain homotopic maps of free R-module complexes
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, let $f_0,f_1:X\to Y$ be morphisms of simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and suppose there is a morphism $h:X\times\Delta[1]\to Y$ with $h\circ i_0=f_0$ and $h\circ i_1=f_1$, where $\Delta[1]$ is the simplicial set with $\Delta[1]_k$ the order-preserving maps $[k]\to[1]$, $X\times\Delta[1]$ is the termwise product and $i_e(x)=(x,\text{constant map }e)$. For a simplicial set $S$ let $C_\bullet(S;R)$ be the chain complex of $R$-modules with $C_k(S;R)=R[S_k]$, the free $R$-module on $S_k$, and differential $\sum_{j=0}^k(-1)^jR[d_j]:C_k\to C_{k-1}$, and for a morphism $u$ of simplicial sets let $C_\bullet(u;R)$ be the induced chain map. Then $C_\bullet(f_0;R)$ and $C_\bullet(f_1;R)$ are chain homotopic; in particular they induce the same maps $H_i(C_\bullet(X;R))\to H_i(C_\bullet(Y;R))$ for all $i$.
